### Meaning
| infl.    | class         | meaning                                                                                                                   |
| -------- | ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| ~        | *n.*          | ruling, rule, royal power, say, governing, control, conquest, colonisation, domination, possession (of land, bodies, etc) |
| yin'thi~ | *self tr. n.* | self-control, restraint / autonomy, independence, self-government                                                         |
| ~en      | *v.*          | to rule, to govern, to control, to dominate, to colonise, to possess                                                      |
| ~an      | *adj.*        | royal, domineering, controlling, possessive                                                                               |
### Etymology
#### Glyph
- 王, a man on a peak reaching for the skies.
- Coincidentally similar to sitelen pona "wawa" (which conveys the power of a person raising their arms in the sky)
#### Sound
- French "roy"
- Maltese/Italian "re"
- *a priori:* r=resonant (domineering?), o=power
